summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (after de_skolemize, before ConjunctiveGraph): nested add_to_cbd helper applies rule 1 (subject triples), rule 2 (recursion into unexpanded blank-node objects with cycle guard), and rule 3 (reification: all triples of any S with rdf:subject = node, no type/predicate/object checks). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the spec counts (8, 3, 2, 0, reified A=8, reified B=13), untyped reifier inclusion, incoming reification exclusion, blank-node reifier non-expansion, blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Tests were not run per instructions; counts were verified by hand only. No commit made; no dependencies added.
